name: The Pond Cypress of Weizigtpark
age_estimate: roughly 125 to 135 years, from bomenbieb's planting band of 1890 to 1900

location.address: Weizigtpark, in a planting bed by the entrance, near the former coach house (Van Baerleplantsoen)

transport: About 700 m west of Dordrecht station, at the Weizigtpark entrance.
verify_notes: bomenbieb.nl: pond cypress standing in a planting bed at the park entrance. Second source Bomenridders Dordrecht confirms independently. See earlier notes.
